verdict.rationale: A direct probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at developer.intuit.com/llms.txt), and nothing in the pack shows agent-oriented or LLM-formatted documentation for an agent to consume. The official MCP server and its docs page are a different capability (serving tools to agents), not docs built for agent ingestion, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
